title: Michael Shermer on the White House UAP science advisory committee

tellings.quote: part of the UF UAP science advisory committee that someone like an avi with connections to people in the government

plain: In a debate with Michael Shermer, a well-known writer and professional skeptic, Michels brings up a White House science advisory committee on UAPs, the official term for UFOs, and suggests it could include someone like an "Avi" with connections to people in the government. The passage is fragmentary, and Michels does not spell out who sits on the committee or what it does; he raises it as part of his argument that the government is now taking the subject seriously.
